lanes.summary: Diff adds F16/IQ4_XS CUDA dequant kernels for Qwen3.5 GDN prefill, chunks the general dense prefill (generate_2.rs) to bound the attention-score buffer and avoid u32 overflow/OOM, gates CUDA-graph replay to first-chunk-only to prevent KV corruption on later chunks, and reworks qk-norm handling so FP8 is disabled but the batched prefill is kept unless a resident-memory estimate says the FP16 cache+workspace won't fit. Verified the last_row/chunk-boundary arithmetic algebraically (matches for both exact-multiple and remainder cases), confirmed WeightQuantType::F16/IQ4XS pre-exist so the new match arms compile, and confirmed dense_prefill_chunk_rows (generate_2.rs) and attention_rows_for (forward_qwen35_cuda_prefill.rs, unchanged) are genuinely separate call sites (general dense path vs Qwen3.5 GDN path) so the near-duplication is cosmetic, not a double-chunk hazard. The ticket's other two sub-issues (qk-norm forced serial removal is addressed; "chat KV 2048" is not) are untouched here, but recent commit history in this worktree shows this is a disclosed, intentional stacked-PR split (#4620 split into root pieces), consistent with the ticket's own 50%/InProgress status — not scope creep or a silent omission.

findings.claim: dense_prefill_chunk_rows sizes chunks using raw num_heads rather than the GQA-aware heads_per_kv the pre-existing, unchanged attention_rows_for (forward_qwen35_cuda_prefill.rs:209-212) uses for the same kind of budget calc. Confirmed these are different call sites (general dense prefill vs Qwen3.5 GDN prefill), so it is not a double-chunking correctness bug — only a more-conservative (smaller than necessary under GQA), non-blocking near-duplication.
findings.fix: Non-blocking; optionally note in the PR why the existing helper wasn't reused, or factor a shared GQA-aware sizing helper in a follow-up.
